script.problem: It reuses a line from the Prep cards word for word.
It has 2 sentences. Explanations are 3 to 5 sentences.

terra.problem: Saying Papa hid in the drawer for years changes his backstory. He was placed there and left behind, not hiding there.
The explanation repeats the verse and its point without much of Papa's distinctive voice.
The baker didn't choose “many”; it was already in the question. Saying the answer was close on that part gives misleading feedback.
The verse says every spirit that confesses Jesus Christ has come in the flesh is from God. It doesn't state the reverse as “every spirit from God” makes it sound.
The verse identifies a spirit that makes this confession as being from God. It doesn't say every spirit from God makes the confession.
Verse 2 specifies confessing that Jesus Christ has come in the flesh. Saying any spirit that confesses Jesus is from God leaves out that qualification.
The explanation repeats the same point several times in a generic voice.
“Right now” and “already here” can imply the writer is speaking about the present day. He says the spirit was already in the world at the time he wrote.
